LanguageData.RHA_Theme032_SwitchDark: Switch to classic dark and remember the choice. Changes interface colors only.
LanguageData.RHA_Theme032_SwitchLight: Switch to light and remember the choice. Changes interface colors only.
LanguageData.RHA_Theme032_SettingHelp: Off uses light panels; on uses the classic charcoal background. Shares the preference with the theme button in RimHex windows. Does not change the game's own interface or fonts.
LanguageData.RHA_Theme032_SaveFailed: The theme preference could not be saved. The previous choice is unchanged. Check that the settings file is writable.
